The ONE contract `scripts/gh_json_fields.py` records gh's own `Available fields` for EVERY subcommand the tree calls (`run list`, `run view`, `pr list`, `pr view`, `issue list`, `issue view`, `label list`, `secret list`, `workflow list`, `repo view` — issue #1160 closed the ~50 reads #1158 left failing only at RUN time, the exact shape that hid for the whole life of the ghost alarm), refuses an unknown field at request-BUILD time, validates a whole argv through `check_argv` (the seam the stub now calls, rule 6m), and `--scan`s every `gh … --json …` call in `scripts/` through the AST naming `file:line` + the command + the field (an argparse `--json` flag is not a gh request; a command the contract has not recorded is a finding, never a silent pass) — **and the REST half (issue #1668): `API_SHAPES` records one entry per `gh api` endpoint FAMILY the tree reads, keyed by the path tail (`issues/{n}`, `pulls/{n}`, `issues/{n}/comments`, `commits/{ref}`, `contents/{path}`, `actions/workflows/{f}/runs`, `actions/runs/{run}` — 14 dotted read paths transcribed from live `gh api` reads), so the SAME `--scan` also reads every `gh api <path> --jq/-q <expr>` call through the AST, resolving f-string endpoints and module string bindings and refusing an unrecorded path with the family, the path and `file:line`; an unrecorded family or an unreadable endpoint/expression is a finding, while a `--jq`/`-q` projection beside a `--json` field list and a fieldless `gh api` call stay exempt** — **and the membership half (issue #1676): when the SAME argv carries `--json <fields>` AND `-q`/`--jq <expr>`, `check_argv()` enforces that exemption's stated reason by parsing the listed fields through `parse_fields()` and requiring EVERY path `jq_paths(expr)` reads to be a MEMBER of that argv's own `--json` list, compared on its TOP-LEVEL segment, and refusing a path outside it with the expression, the path and the listed fields — `gh pr list --json number -q .title` exits 0 on `origin/master` and 1 here, `tests/test_gh_json_fields.py::test_a_planted_json_projection_path_is_refused` proves it RED against the base contract, and `jq_paths` returning None stays tolerated**; `make lint` bundles the scan so `qa-validate`'s first gate and the fix loop run it. The suite pins EVERY recorded set against gh's transcribed answer list, drives the REAL scan green here and RED on a planted unknown field in EACH subcommand, treats an unreadable `--json` expression as a finding and a missing `scripts/` tree as exit 2 (never a silent clean), and proves the ghost stub gh refuses `htmlUrl` while answering `url`; `scripts/ghost_run_alarm.py` also checks each gh ANSWER's shape (`run list` is an array, `run view --json jobs` is `{"jobs": […]}` — measured: an answer treated as `[]` printed 50 false ghosts where the real shape check found 3) and maps a missing `gh` to the same loud `READ FAILED` exit 2, never a traceback |

**2. Composition — GAP (underspecified; the primary row does NOT satisfy #1671).**
- The proposed row carries `test_a_planted_json_projection_path_is_refused` x1, but `test_a_planted_jq_path_is_refused` x0 and `test_the_api_read_surface_is_recorded` x0. #1671's Done-when explicitly requires naming BOTH of those guards, so the #1685-only row does NOT satisfy #1671.
